Title: ② Webflow Conf 2022 – Pat Szot

URL Source: http://patrickszot.webflow.io/recent-work/webflow-conf

Markdown Content:
Webflow provides the building blocks — and creatives use them, with uninhibited imagination, to experiment and break through barriers. By combining the visual language of transparency and the power of the the system, grid, and structure that does it all, we’re giving our community a chance to see right through us and go inside the interface and it’s many layers. Our visual system layers grids, gradients, our 2D and 3D “artifact” layer to play with depth and space in delightfully unexpected ways. We’ve created a unique visual playground that can move and flex to a maximalist brand in one moment, and a platform for the community in the next.
